slice: GitHub Issue #50 — MongoDB message persistence duration

environment.external_services: deterministic mocks and in-memory MetricsModule Adapter

test_results.observation: The approved persistence Histogram name, outcome label, seconds unit, and exposition contract are present.
Acknowledged Message.findOneAndUpdate and Message.create success paths each emit one success observation, and timing is completed before Redis cache work.
Timeout, write-concern, transaction-abort, exhausted-retry, and ambiguous-result fixtures each emit exactly one failed observation.
Duplicate-key recovery performs a verification lookup while retaining one logical persistence observation.
A duplicate with matching identity and canonical persisted payload is returned as a verified duplicate and recorded as success.
Payload mismatch and unverified duplicate-key results are returned as failed and never recorded as success.
evidence: server/test/saveMessageInBackground.test.js → mismatch and unverified duplicate cases passed

test_results.observation: The already-persisted Message.findById lookup path emits no persistence Histogram observation.
evidence: server/test/saveMessageInBackground.test.js → pre-existing message lookup exclusion case passed

test_results.observation: The largest finite persistence bucket is 10 seconds, covering the approved timeout boundary.
Persistence observations contain only the bounded outcome label; high-cardinality identifiers do not enter the metric contract.
evidence: server/test/saveMessageInBackground.test.js → exact persistence observation payload assertions passed

test_results.observation: Metrics observation failure does not change the persistence result, and the full server regression remains green.
